source_lines_after.45: 1.1 The prespectrum construction constructs $T_r$ as a based CW complex. Over a $d$-dimensional Schubert cell of $BO(r)$, its Thom attachment contributes cells of dimension $d+r$, with $d\ge0$; hence every cell outside the basepoint has dimension at least $r$. Apply the published high-relative-cells lemma to the CW pair $(T_r,*)$: it is $(r-1)$-connected. In particular $T_r$ is path-connected and simply connected for $r\ge2$. The basepoint is a vertex.
